parsed.rationale: All 15 members are unnamed extensions (name: "") on SwiftUI's `View` type, spread across 7 distinct packages (WXUI, Wallpaper, PartyHorn, PlayerHeaderView, MusicShareKit, app:iOS) and covering unrelated domain concerns such as GlassEffect compatibility, OverlaySheet layout, PlaybackBlendMode, ThemePickerGesture, WipeDownRevealModifier, AccentColorEnvironment, and StatusBarStyleModifier. The structural signal is purely that they all extend `View`; there are no shared fields, no shared methods listed (fields_or_signature is empty for every record), and no Jaccard or shared-field-count evidence. Extending `View` in a file-local extension is idiomatic SwiftUI practice and the coincidence of the extended type name is entirely structural. No consolidation is warranted.
